acceptance_tests: ERC re-run reports 0 errors and 0 warnings (baseline 10 errors / 8 warnings).
DRC re-run against generic_two_layer reports 0 errors and 0 warnings (baseline 5 errors / 13 warnings).
Netlist vs pin-table cross-check shows zero unconnected pins and zero single-pin nets, including U2.1/U2.2/U2.3/U2.4 and VBUS.
Every power_in pin is on a net with a power driver or PWR_FLAG.
3V3 rail measures 3.3 V +/-3% at 0 mA and 500 mA load with <=50 mV p-p ripple.
I2C scan detects exactly one device at 0x48 and temperature reads within +/-2 C of reference at 25 C.
Board enumerates over USB-C and flashes firmware without manual strapping.
All placed components lie inside the 110 x 65 mm outline with >=1 mm edge clearance and a clear antenna keepout.
Gerbers, drill, BOM, and pick-and-place generate cleanly and pass generic_two_layer fabrication sanity checks.
Every requirement ID in this document is traced to a schematic, layout, or test artifact (100% coverage).
constraints: Board outline fixed at 35,35 to 145,100 (110 x 65 mm); all components must fit inside with >=1 mm edge clearance.
Two-layer generic_two_layer stackup only: min trace 0.2 mm, min clearance 0.2 mm, min drill 0.3 mm, 1.6 mm thickness.
ESP32-WROOM-32 antenna keepout (>=15 x 10 mm) must be copper-free and placed over a board edge.
J1 is currently a USB_B_Micro symbol and must be migrated to a USB-C receptacle with CC pins and shield.
Netlist error to correct: GND is tied to U2.5 (ADD0) instead of U2.2 (GND).
U2.VCC, U2.SDA, U2.SCL, U1.GPIO21, U1.GPIO22, U1.GPIO25, and VBUS are currently unconnected or single-pin nets.
The 3V3 net presently only reaches U1.1 and U1.8; U1.8 is EN and must be pulled up through 10 k rather than hard-tied to 3V3.
No regulator exists in the current design; a VBUS-to-3V3 regulator must be added.
PWR_FLAG symbols must be assigned to power nets to satisfy ERC driver checks.
Total draw limited to USB default power (500 mA) - no high-power sink negotiation.
TMP102 must be thermally isolated from the regulator and ESP32 to bound self-heating error.
Requirements stage is proposal-only: no project files, schematic, or layout are modified at this stage.

interfaces.type: I2C (fast mode, up to 400 kHz, 4.7 k pull-ups, TMP102 at 0x48)
USB-C 2.0 (power + D+/D- data, 90 ohm differential, ESD protected)
Programming/debug UART or native USB flashing path

power.input: USB-C VBUS, 5 V nominal (4.75-5.25 V), 5.1 k CC pulldowns advertising a sink
power.logic_voltage: 3.3 V +/-3% from an LDO regulator (>=600 mA capability)

requirements.statement: The board shall be powered from a USB-C receptacle providing 5 V nominal on VBUS (4.75-5.25 V), with CC1/CC2 each pulled to GND through 5.1 k resistors to advertise a USB-C sink.
A 3V3 LDO regulator shall convert VBUS to a 3.3 V +/-3% logic rail with at least 600 mA continuous output capability and internal thermal/current-limit protection.
The 3V3 rail shall supply peak current of at least 500 mA to cover ESP32-WROOM-32 Wi-Fi transmit bursts.
Regulator input shall have 1 uF and regulator output 10 uF ceramic capacitors placed within 5 mm of the regulator pins.
A 100 uF bulk capacitor shall be placed on the 3V3 rail near U1 to buffer Wi-Fi transmit current peaks.
Each supply pin of U1 and U2 shall have a 100 nF decoupling capacitor placed within 3 mm of the pin.
Total board current draw from VBUS shall not exceed 500 mA, with average draw at or below 150 mA.
PWR_FLAG symbols (#FLG01, #FLG02) shall be attached to the VBUS and 3V3/GND nets so ERC sees a driver for every power net.
U2.VCC (TMP102 pin 1) shall connect to the 3V3 net; it is currently unconnected in the netlist.
U2.GND (TMP102 pin 2) shall connect to the GND net; the netlist currently ties GND to U2.5 (ADD0) instead.
A single GND net shall be common to USB-C shield/GND, regulator, U1.GND, and U2.GND with no isolated ground islands.
The ESP32 EN pin shall be pulled to 3V3 through 10 k with a 100 nF capacitor to GND for a power-on reset delay of approximately 1 ms.
One I2C bus shall connect U1.GPIO21 (SDA) to U2.SDA and U1.GPIO22 (SCL) to U2.SCL at 3.3 V logic levels.
SDA and SCL shall each have a 4.7 k pull-up to 3V3; total bus capacitance shall not exceed 400 pF.
The I2C bus shall operate from 100 kHz up to 400 kHz (fast mode).
TMP102 ADD0 shall be tied to GND through a dedicated 0 ohm/net stub selecting 7-bit I2C address 0x48, and shall not be shared with the GND power net symbol as a substitute for pin 2.
USB D+/D- shall route as a 90 ohm differential pair with length matching within 2.5 mm, and ESD protection (<=3 pF per line) shall be placed within 10 mm of the connector on both lines.
One USB-C 2.0 receptacle shall provide power and data; the current USB_B_Micro symbol for J1 shall be replaced with a USB-C footprint including CC pins and shield.
USB D+/D- from J1 shall reach the ESP32 USB/UART path (native USB pins or a USB-UART bridge); no bidirectional pin shall be left driverless.
GPIO0 shall have a 10 k pull-up to 3V3 and an optional BOOT button to GND so the default strapping selects normal boot.
Board outline shall remain 110 mm x 65 mm (35,35 to 145,100) with all components placed fully inside and at least 1 mm edge clearance.
The PCB shall be 2 layers, 1.6 mm thick, per the generic_two_layer manufacturer profile.
The ESP32-WROOM-32 antenna region shall be a copper-free keepout of at least 15 mm x 10 mm, positioned over a board edge.
The USB-C connector shall be placed on a board edge with its mating face flush to the outline and at least 5 mm of surrounding keepout for the cable overmould.
The TMP102 shall be placed at least 15 mm from the regulator and the ESP32 module, with thermal relief (no large pour tie) to limit self-heating measurement error.
Four M3 mounting holes (3.2 mm diameter) shall be placed 5 mm inboard from each corner of the outline.
Minimum trace width shall be 0.2 mm, minimum clearance 0.2 mm, and minimum drill 0.3 mm per generic_two_layer rules; power traces shall be at least 0.5 mm wide.
The bottom layer shall carry a continuous GND pour stitched to the top ground with vias at intervals of 10 mm or less, excluding the antenna keepout.
ERC shall report 0 errors and 0 warnings, down from the 10 errors / 8 warnings baseline.
DRC shall report 0 errors and 0 warnings against the generic_two_layer profile, down from the 5 errors / 13 warnings baseline.
Every power_in pin (U1.1, U1.2, U2.1, U2.2) shall be connected to a net that has at least one power driver or PWR_FLAG.
Generated Gerbers, drill files, BOM, and pick-and-place files shall pass a sanity check against generic_two_layer fabrication rules with 100% requirement coverage traced to this document.
The exported netlist shall match the pin table with zero unconnected pins and zero single-pin nets.
Measured 3V3 rail shall be within 3.3 V +/-3% at 0 mA and at 500 mA load, with ripple at or below 50 mV peak-to-peak.
An I2C bus scan shall detect exactly one device at address 0x48 and return temperature readings within +/-2 C of a reference at 25 C ambient.
The board shall enumerate over USB-C and accept firmware flashing without manual strapping intervention.
